title: Nandi
brief_description: Stone sculpture of Nandi, the sacred bull and divine vehicle (Vahana) of Lord Shiva.
detailed_description: This sculpture depicts Nandi in a seated posture, symbolizing devotion, strength, purity, and unwavering faith. Nandi is traditionally placed facing the Shiva Linga in Hindu temples and is regarded as the guardian of Shiva's abode. The sculpture features ornamental carvings around the neck and body, reflecting the artistic style of the Kadamba period. Such sculptures were commonly installed in temple complexes throughout Goa and served as important religious icons representing loyalty, protection, and spiritual discipline.
